name: own_settings
claim: We use the adaptive interval update of Smith; our experiments set the learning rate to 0.05, a choice made here.
evidence: Smith proposes an adaptive interval update with a user-specified learning rate.

name: own_result
claim: Smith shows ranking is invariant under strictly monotone transformations; our new Corollary 4.7 extends this result to the decision rule.
evidence: Smith proves that strictly monotone transformations preserve the ranking of all scores.

name: global
claim: Smith documents global underconfidence: accuracy is at least confidence at every confidence level.
evidence: Smith measures aggregate underconfidence: mean accuracy exceeds mean confidence. This does not establish any pointwise statement; at confidence 0.8, accuracy is 0.6.

name: wrong_rate
evidence: Smith proves the bound $R_T\le c\sqrt{T}\,K\log K$.
